description: US weather alerts summary — Snapshot of every active US National Weather Service alert: national totals (land and marine), the states and marine areas with the most alerts, counts by event type (Winter Storm Warning, Flood Warning...) and severity, and the most severe alerts with headline, areas, onset and end. Optional area= a 2-letter state or marine area code (e.g. TX) to focus the breakdown on one area, limit=1-30 most severe alerts (default 10). Source: api.weather.gov (public domain). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_alerts_summary
